parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: If the ETag specified in the request matches the ETag of the object, the object is returned with HTTP status code 200 OK. If the ETag specified in the request does not match the ETag of the object, HTTP status code 412 Precondition Failed is returned.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The start date of the function invocation, in the **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT** format.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The trace ID, which is the unique identifier of the request in the call chain.

parameters.name: qualifier
parameters.description: The service alias or LATEST. Versions are not supported.
